title: Lake beer & wine trail
intro: Eight brewery and wine stops around Hawley, Tafton, Greentown and Honesdale. Pick a small outing, check current opening hours, and save the places you want to visit.
transport: Arrange a designated driver or transport before tasting. These stops are spread across several towns; this is not a walking or boating route.

stops.name: Wallenpaupack Brewing Company
stops.note: Hawley brewpub serving its own beer and food.

stops.name: Hopping Eagle Brewing Company
stops.note: Small-batch brewery now on Route 6. The former Silk Mill location has moved.

stops.name: Log Tavern Brewing Co. - Tafton
stops.note: Tafton taproom with snack food and an outdoor beer garden. Friendly leashed pets are permitted outdoors.

stops.name: Jam Room Brewing Company
stops.note: Greentown brewery with a beer menu and live-event calendar.

stops.name: Here & Now Brewing Company
stops.note: Downtown Honesdale brewery and restaurant with pizza, a bar and takeaway beer. Kitchen and bar hours differ.

stops.name: Runaway Train Brewery: Brewhouse + Saloon
stops.note: Brewery and saloon at 2 Chapel Street, with food and a seasonal pet-friendly outdoor patio.

stops.name: Three Hammers Wine Lounge on Main
stops.note: Three Hammers’ Wine Lounge on Main in downtown Honesdale. This is separate from the winery on Welcome Lake Road.

stops.name: Three Hammers Winery
stops.note: The winery itself, on a 15-acre property with a pond on Welcome Lake Road north-east of Hawley. Walk-in tastings, wine by the glass and bottle, outdoor seating in good weather. No kitchen and no outside food; pets are not allowed, service dogs excepted. Its site lists it open daily.

outings.title: Hawley breweries and winery
outings.note: Two breweries around Hawley and Three Hammers Winery, about six miles north-east on Welcome Lake Road; arrange transport between them.

outings.title: Tafton & Greentown
outings.note: Two separate stops on the east and south sides of the lake; leave time for the drive.

outings.title: Honesdale beer & wine
outings.note: Two breweries and a wine lounge in Honesdale. Check each venue’s hours, especially the wine lounge.
